newsitem.title: MEXICO: BankAmerica grants Carso $103 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: BankAmerica grants Carso $103 mln loan.

text.p: BankAmerica Corp's Bank of America has granted a bridge loan of $103 million to Mexican holding company Grupo Carso to settle the payment of the 60-percent stake it bought in retail chain Sears Roebuck de Mexico, a source from the bank said on Friday.
"It is a 90-day bridge loan that had to be extended to Grupo Carso due to the promptness with which it needed to settle the Sears deal," the source said.
"We will replace it later with a medium-term loan for between three and five years, and that will be finalized over the next two months," the source added.
The loan was granted on Thursday at a rate of Libor plus 35 basis points, the source said, adding that the details had been agreed to two weeks previously.
